name: What is the typical process for a framing repair project with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a framing repair project with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our framing repair process typically begins with an initial consultation and thorough onsite inspection to assess the damage and identify its root cause. Following the assessment, we provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, and estimated costs. Once approved, we handle any necessary permitting and schedule the repair work. During the repair, our team takes measures to protect your property and ensure safety, concluding with a final inspection to confirm the quality and integrity of the work. We prioritize clear communication at every stage, keeping you informed of progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our framing repair process involves an initial consultation and inspection, followed by a detailed proposal, permitting, and scheduled repair work. We conclude with a final inspection, maintaining clear communication throughout.
